decision.title: Rate limiting for public API
decision.context: Public API is exposed to third-party integrators with different usage patterns.

statement.technical_goal: Prevent abuse and resource exhaustion while allowing legitimate integrations to function.
statement.assumptions: Most clients behave in good faith and follow documented usage limits.
statement.conscious_simplifications: We apply a global rate limit per API key instead of per-endpoint limits.
statement.non_negotiables: API must remain available for critical integrations.
statement.accepted_worst_case: Aggressive clients may temporarily affect performance before limits are enforced.
